enrichment.headline: Adds $29,884 to Silicon Valley Paving's Oakland Tech asphalt contract after damage near the gym
enrichment.summary: This change order adds $29,884.00 to the paving contract to repair about 3,520 square feet of asphalt near the Boys' Gym at Oakland Technical High School. A painting contractor damaged the new asphalt, and the text says that contractor agreed to a charge back, meaning it will repay the cost. The contract's not-to-exceed amount rises from $559,716.00 to $589,599.00.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Silicon Valley Paving, Inc. – Oakland Technical High School Asphalt Replacement Project – Buildings and Grounds Department

enrichment.headline: Pays ACC Environmental $50,623 for asbestos testing and monitoring at the Cole Campus offices
enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants will inspect and sample suspect asbestos-containing materials and monitor the air and the cleanup of asbestos pipe and boiler insulation at the main building of the Central Administration at Cole Campus. The lump-sum price is $50,623.00, and work runs from February 27, 2025 to June 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. – Central Administration at Cole Campus - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Extends CAL FIRE living schoolyards planning grant on 15 campuses to May 31, 2025
enrichment.summary: The district has a state grant of $2,798,074.20 from the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) to plan living schoolyards on fifteen campuses, including community design work, soil testing and a geotechnical report. This amendment moves the end date from March 30, 2025 to May 31, 2025. The text states no change in the dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
